title: Philadelphia Africatown Walking Food Tour
includes: A guided stroll through the heart of Africatown
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the vibrant culinary landscape of Philadelphia’s Africatown community on a guided walking tour. Sample four delectable bites, featuring flavors from West African, Jamaican, Southern American, and Italian cuisines. Meet local chefs and shop owners, gaining insight into their stories and the rich history of Southwest Philly. This two-hour tour not only satisfies your taste buds but also supports local businesses and promotes cultural understanding in this diverse neighborhood.

- Enjoy four unique tastings that represent Africatown's diverse culinary influences.
- Meet local chefs and learn about their contributions to the community.
- Visit independent shops that reflect the spirit of this thriving area.
- Limited to 12 guests for an intimate experience with a knowledgeable guide.
